name: Yuhara Kouichi
source:
3rd year high school student. The protagonist's childhood friend and neighbor. An honor student with superior grades.
He used to be in the fencing club, but he had to quit because of the injury he sustained protecting the protagonist from an accident.
But because of that he got the chance to go out with her.
